observations: Photo 0: one adult mountain bicycle standing on a concrete floor outdoors, shot from the rear left side.
Photo 0: dark grey frame with neon yellow-green graphics; a front suspension fork with yellow-green lowers; no rear shock, so it is a hardtail.
Photo 0: disc brakes front and rear, rear derailleur and a multi-sprocket rear cassette, front chainrings with a front derailleur, bottle cage mount on the down tube.
Photo 0: tyres look inflated with tread; saddle and handlebar present; no obvious frame damage from this angle.
Photo 0: no brand name or model can be read on the frame; graphics are too small and angled.
Only one photo; a dealer watermark is on it. Nothing shows the gears shifting or the brakes working.

identity.kind: adult hardtail mountain bike with front suspension and disc brakes
read_from: photo 0 frame, fork, brakes and gears

claims.evidence: No brand or model readable in photo 0; quality cannot be judged from one distant shot.
Photo 0 shows front and rear derailleurs and a multi-sprocket cassette, but the sprocket count cannot be read.
Photo 0 shows a front suspension fork; there is no rear shock, so only the front is sprung.

risks.risk: Gears may not shift cleanly or the derailleur hanger may be bent.
risks.proof: A clip of the bike on a stand or being ridden, shifting through all gears front and rear.

risks.risk: Disc brakes may be worn or not working, and the suspension fork may be seized or leaking.
risks.proof: A clip squeezing each brake while pushing the bike, and compressing the front fork by hand.
risks.if_unproven: as brakes and fork needing service

risks.risk: Frame cracks, dents or a bent wheel not visible from one side.
risks.proof: Photos of the other side of the bike and close-ups of the frame joints, and a clip spinning each wheel.
risks.if_unproven: as having cosmetic damage and wheels needing truing

risks.risk: Brand and frame size unknown, which affect the price.
risks.proof: A close-up of the brand name on the down tube and of the size marking on the seat tube.
A close-up of the frame serial number under the bottom bracket.
risks.if_unproven: held for serial check before payment

proof_requests: Close-up of the brand name on the frame and of the serial number under the bottom bracket, with a handwritten code with today's date in shot.
Clip of the bike shifting through all gears and braking.
Photo of the other side of the bike and close-ups of the frame joints.
Close-up of the rear cassette and front chainrings to count the gears.
response.reason: Photo 0 clearly shows an adult hardtail mountain bike with front suspension and disc brakes, so it can be priced by type at its worst case, unbranded and needing service, until the brand, gear clip and serial are shown.
